messages:
Maya: Morning — nightly eval flagged two cohorts failing on rwd-3-small-int4-2026-03-19.

eval-bot: [ALERT] nightly-eval | suites: billing_clarify_v2 (FAIL), safety_convo (FAIL) | metric: exact_match_drop=+18% vs baseline | severity=P2 | top-suspects: quantization/tokenizer

Sam: ping @Indra any idea if this aligns with the int4 rollout yesterday?

Maya: assigning @Indra as initial owner. Adding @Devon for infra checks.

Indra: looking. Can you dump a few failing sample ids? eval-bot said it attached them but I don't see the payload.

Maya: pasted two sample ids below and a quick fetch command:
```
> sample_ids: ["samp-22f3", "samp-8a9b", "samp-6c1d"]
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_API" "https://eval.internal/api/samples?id=samp-22f3" -o samp-22f3.json
```

Devon: I'll spin a float32 runner on a small canary to compare outputs. ETA ~25m.

Liam: any chance prompt template changed? billing_clarify_v2 had a recent paraphrase update yesterday.

Indra: fetching samples now. Quick diff between float32 and int4 tokens shows a tokenizer alignment error on one prompt — leading to truncation mid-sentence in ~30% of failing cases.

Sam: if tokenizer mismatch that's upstream — did we change tokenizers during model retokenization/packing? @Maya

Maya: yes — we rolled the packed vocab for rwd-3 yesterday to unify subword merges. Noted.

Indra: hypothesis: new merges + int4 aggressive KV/cache packing produce different prefix boundaries; model generates truncated completions -> EM drop. Running targeted eval against pre-rollout quant profile.

eval-bot: quick stats run:
- billing_clarify_v2: EM_drop = 18.4%, top diff token idx mean shift = 2.1
- safety_convo: EM_drop = 12.7%, more variance in long-turn prompts

Devon: infra note: canary float32 runner up; I've posted the raw outputs to GCS: gs://rwd-evals/canary/2501234567/

Indra: pulled the outputs. Example failure (samp-22f3) — int4 output truncated at "...please refer to your" whereas float32 completes "...please refer to your billing statement dated May 2024." Small change but EM sensitive.

Sam: immediate mitigation options:
1) rollback quant-profile to qc-2026-03-17 (fast)
2) pin tokenizer to previous packed-vocab v2026-03-16 (requires rebuild)
3) add prompt-level prefix cache bypass for affected cohorts

Maya: prefer rollback + follow-up roll-forward with tokenizer and quant test. @Devon can you prepare rollback plan and time estimate?

Devon: can do. Rolling back profile qc-2026-03-17 to the dedicated pool would take ~6m to propagate; I'll schedule a 10m canary then promote if green.

ops-bot: started canary rollback: action=rollback_quant_profile profile=qc-2026-03-17 target=dedicated-pool-3 status=running

Maya: owners and next steps:
- Owner (investigation): Indra
- Infra rollback/run: Devon
- Data/sample collection + eval plots: Liam
- Notify onsite support if canary fails: Sam

Indra: I'll produce a 1-pager with top 20 failing prompts, token diffs, and suggested fix (revert vocab merges / rebuild tokenizer + quant test). ETA 2h.

Sam: if rollback doesn't recover, escalate P1 and engage release team. For now P2.

Maya: thanks all. I'll update the incident tracker and ping support rota. :thumbsup:

Liam: noted — collecting plots and will post link when ready.

Indra: initial attachment: top failing prompt list and token overlap histogram: https://internal/drive/att/2501234567/top20.csv

Maya: closing loop for now — will post post-mortem template once root cause confirmed.
